title: 5 highlights of the US govt’s report on China’s military: Claims on Arunachal and more
description: The US Department of Defense’s report on China reveals the country’s emphasis on Taiwan and the South China Sea, its goal for “great rejuvenation,” and its military’s anti-corruption efforts.
